gouwu.instruction: Pick up the basket with the right gripper. Use the left gripper to pick up the bottle from the wooden table and place it in the basket. Transfer the basket to the left gripper, then use the right gripper to pick up the bottle from the white counter and place it in the basket.

toulaji.instruction: Use the left and right grippers to pick up one bottle each from the wooden table. Move to the trash bin, lower the torso, and drop both bottles into the bin one at a time.
